actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.generate_text.description: Generate a text response using Cohere AI Chat API
actions.generate_text.props.maxTokens.de: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Leave empty for model default.
actions.generate_text.props.model.descri: The Cohere model to use for generation
actions.generate_text.props.prompt.descr: The user message to send to the model
Controls randomness (0.0 = deterministic, 1.0 = maximum randomness). Default: 0.3
auth.description:
To obtain your Cohere API Key:

1. Go to the [Cohere Dashboard](https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys).
2. Sign in or create a free account.
3. Navigate to **API Keys** in the left sidebar.
4. Click **Create Trial Key** (free) or use a production key.
5. Copy the key and paste it below.
